name: Nook
description:
Your smart home from the top bar: lights, plugs, sensors, cameras, air conditioners, TVs and speakers, from Home Assistant, Hue, HomeKit, Smart Life, Mi Home, eWeLink and the local network.

Needs the Nook app (io.github.epogonii.nook-app, on Flathub), which talks to the devices; the extension draws the menu. While the screen is locked, Nook only turns Xiaomi gateway leak and smoke alerts into notifications. The copy button for donation addresses uses the clipboard; nothing is read from it.
